reason: I already paid for salon software once and my staff never touched it, so it got cancelled. Now you want five thousand upfront and want my customer list sitting on everybody's phones, and nobody has told me where that data is kept.
objection: What if the phone breaks or a stylist leaves with it? I lose my customers' numbers and wallet balances, and my register at least never crashes.
would_change_my_mind: Written proof that all my data is backed up off the phone and can be restored on a new one. Also, no setup fee until my staff are actually using it after the free month.
